children: Morrow Bank AB agreed to sell MedMera’s Swedish NPL portfolio (approx. SEK 786M GBV) to Arktika Capital at a premium to book. With last week’s NPL sales, the Bank expects its NPL ratio to fall below 5% post-close, subject to Swedish FSA approval and expected in Q4 2026.
De-risks balance sheet; reduces impaired assets exposure.
Deal at premium to book value
Positive capital effect and signals strong pricing versus carrying value.
Improves asset quality metrics; may lower funding costs.
Timing and approval are key; any delay could defer benefits.
Potential uplift to CET1/leverage, enhancing resilience.

This is a follow-through on post-acquisition cleanup of non-core/NPL assets after buying MedMera, accelerating de-risking. A larger catalyst would be confirmed capital ratio uplift at close and evidence of lower funding costs or improved profitability from a cleaner book.
